objective: evaluate the frozen HPA two-channel raw-IF CNN once on an independent-provider, optically validated organelle-landmark confocal collection

source_contract.provider: Image Data Resource / University of Dundee
source_contract.landing_page_claim: 789011 murine and 523319 human optically validated confocal micrographs covering 17 and 20 EGFP landmark proteins

annotation_contract.key_normalization: Unicode casefold and remove non-alphanumeric characters

sampling_contract.selection: salted SHA-256 order within screen, plate, well, landmark protein, and canonical class
sampling_contract.split_or_metric_unit: landmark protein and plate, never individual image alone

image_contract.channel_name_normalization: Unicode casefold and remove non-alphanumeric characters
image_contract.channel_resolution: exactly one nucleus and one target channel must match their token sets; ambiguity or absence refuses the image
image_contract.z_projection: maximum intensity projection per selected channel
image_contract.per_channel_scaling: finite p1/p99 clipping to [0,1] with all-zero output when p99 is not above p1
image_contract.geometry: center-crop to square then area-resize to 128x128

evaluation_contract.thresholds_temperature_and_conformal: use frozen HPA checkpoint values unchanged
evaluation_contract.prediction_aggregation: report image-level diagnostics and arithmetic-mean logits per landmark protein and plate

authority_contract.reason_uncertainty_authority_false: many cell images from a landmark construct are technical observations rather than independent biological replicates

failure_policy.endpoint_failure: retain as independent-provider diagnostic only and permanently consume selected images
failure_policy.endpoint_success: promote raw-IF localization representation to independent-provider domain-shift validated while retaining uncertainty and Aleph authority blocks
